verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a web service, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows SAM.gov can be deployed on your own infrastructure. The evidence only covers access to the GSA-hosted APIs (api.sam.gov / api-alpha.sam.gov), which require SAM.gov-issued API keys and approved System Accounts. The bulk API Extract lets you pull data, but copying data is not the same as self-hosting the core product.
